patch_description: This crossover retains the current program’s one-parameter-per-repeat economy while adopting the inspiration program’s independently meaningful collective RY structure. The tied RZ layer is removed because it constrains the same angle to two different rotation axes, and the final RZ layer also commutes with the Z-Z readout. The resulting block uses six circuit parameters plus gain and bias (eight total), while reducing the circuit from 138 to 90 ansatz gates. Collective RY rotations provide the noncommuting trainable dynamics, and the fixed CZ chain propagates correlations across all qubits.
